title: Step 70-A Inventory Procurement POS canonical handoff and scope freeze

Step70 owns Step56-D AD-D-06..18 (13 Inventory/Procurement surfaces, 77 source-traced operations) plus Step56-E AD-E-09..11 (3 POS surfaces, 19 design obligations). acceptance_criteria.description: Step69 closure and post-closure sync are terminal/canonical and main is exactly da446535d29ad4e6a95197a4d0a6058c8d27654e before Step70-A mutation.
Step70 source ownership freezes exactly 16 surfaces: AD-D-06..18 and AD-E-09..11, with 77 Inventory/Procurement + 19 POS = 96 source/design-traced operations.

The live POS authority gap is frozen without upgrade: 11 controller+supplemental-contract operations remain absent from canonical assembled OpenAPI; 8 canonical-OpenAPI operations remain without source controller. All 19 POS operations remain blocked from frontend execution until canonical 70-B reconciliation.

Inventory/Procurement source-specific invariants from AD-D-06..18 are retained, including FIFO/cost boundaries, adjustment Step-Up/idempotency, transfer/reservation/allocation lifecycle limits, warehouse protection If-Match, procurement separation-of-duties, receipt/landed-cost/return Step-Up/idempotency and invoice read limitations.

No unsupported guarantee is introduced: approval does not reserve transfer stock, ship does not claim fresh free-stock recheck, warehouse scope is not claimed uniform where source omits it, supplier delete/payment endpoints are not invented, and purchase-return approval does not claim fresh receipt-ownership recheck.
70-A makes no runtime, API/OpenAPI, generated-contract, database, workflow/dependency, Product Design semantic or Step71 implementation mutation.

70-B remains blocked until exact-head Canonical CI/Phase A/CodeQL, deterministic Review, exact-artifact Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release complete for 70-A.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step70-A is MEDIUM-risk documentation/governance handoff and requires no Project Owner Human Gate. Step70-B mutation remains blocked until terminal 70-A canonical closure.
